title: seseli bulgaricum
intro: Seseli bulgaricum, commonly known as Bulgarian Angelica or Balkan Angelica, is a perennial plant belonging to the carrot family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its numerous health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Seseli bulgaricum include its ability to relieve pain, reduce inflammation, and promote expectoration, making it a valuable natural remedy for respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Seseli bulgaricum include seselin, apiol, and other essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic effects.
